{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace_checks
# Capture top-level metadata of /working
{ ls -lad /working 2>&1 || true; echo; stat /working 2>&1 || true; } > temp_workspace_checks/original_state.txt

# Full recursive listing
ls -laR /working > temp_workspace_checks/raw_listing.txt 2>&1 || true

# Extract candidate paths named exactly "workspace" (use find to ensure correct full paths)
find /working -name workspace -print > temp_workspace_checks/matches_candidates.txt 2>/dev/null || true

# For each candidate, collect filesystem metadata and append to type_checks.txt
: > temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ ! -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p|missing|0|---|---" >> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
    continue
  fi
  stat_out=$(stat -c "%F|%s|%a|%U:%G" -- "$p" 2>&1) || stat_rc=$?
  if [ "${stat_rc:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$p|ERROR|$stat_out" >> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
    unset stat_rc
  else
    echo "$p|$stat_out" >> temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/matches_candidates.txt

# Normalize and deduplicate candidate paths (do not resolve symlinks here)
python3 - <<'PY' > temp_workspace_checks/unique_candidates.txt
import os
seen=set()
for line in open('temp_workspace_checks/type_checks.txt'):
    line=line.rstrip('\n')
    if not line: continue
    parts=line.split('|')
    path=parts[0]
    np=os.path.normpath(path)
    if np not in seen:
        seen.add(np)
        print(np)
PY

# For each unique candidate, resolve references (symlinks) to final target and record metadata
: > temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if command -v readlink >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    resolved=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null) || resolved=""
  else
    resolved=$(realpath --no-newline "$p" 2>/dev/null) || resolved=""
  fi
  if [ -z "$resolved" ]; then resolved="$p"; fi
  if [ ! -e "$resolved" ] && [ ! -L "$resolved" ]; then
    echo "$p|$resolved|missing|0|---|---" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
    continue
  fi
  stat_out=$(stat -c "%F|%s|%a|%U:%G" -- "$resolved" 2>&1) || stat_rc=$?
  if [ "${stat_rc:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "$p|$resolved|ERROR|$stat_out" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
    unset stat_rc
  else
    echo "$p|$resolved|$stat_out" >> temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/unique_candidates.txt

# Produce concise summary noting which resolved targets are regular files; include permission/access errors
: > temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && continue
  IFS='|' read -r orig resolved rest <<< "$line"
  if echo "$rest" | grep -q '^ERROR' ; then
    echo "$orig|$resolved|error|$rest" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
    continue
  fi
  if echo "$rest" | grep -q '^missing' ; then
    echo "$orig|$resolved|missing|$rest" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
    continue
  fi
  ftype=$(echo "$rest" | cut -d'|' -f1)
  if [ "$ftype" = "regular file" ]; then
    echo "$orig|$resolved|regular file|$rest" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
  else
    echo "$orig|$resolved|not regular file|$rest" >> temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt
  fi
done < temp_workspace_checks/resolved_candidates.txt

# Decision placeholder: presence of any regular-file verdict -> single-line result
if grep -q '|regular file|' temp_workspace_checks/summary.txt 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "yes" > temp_workspace_checks/decision.txt
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no" > temp_workspace_checks/decision.txt
  echo "no"
fi
"}
